### Global params 


# Number of trials per simulation

```{r}

### Win Stay Lose Shift agent -- from Riccardo 


agent_wsls <- function(prevChoice, feedback, noise = 0) { ## Implementation of probabilistic version
  # Input validation
  if (!prevChoice %in% c(0, 1)) stop("Previous choice must be 0 or 1.")
  if (!feedback %in% c(0, 1)) stop("Feedback must be 0 or 1.")
  if (!is.numeric(noise) || noise < 0 || noise > 1) stop("Noise must be a probability between 0 and 1.")

  # Core WSLS logic:
  # If feedback is 1 (win), stay: choice = prevChoice
  # If feedback is 0 (loss), shift: choice = 1 - prevChoice
  choice <- ifelse(feedback == 1, prevChoice, 1 - prevChoice)

  # Apply noise if specified
  if (noise > 0 && runif(1) < noise) {
    # Override with a random 50/50 choice
    choice <- sample(c(0, 1), 1)
  }

  return(choice)
}


```




```{r}


### Reinforcement Learning agent 


agent_rl <- function(prevChoice, feedback, omega = 0.1) {
  
  # Input validation 
  if (!prevChoice %in% c(0, 1)) stop("Previous choice must be 0 or 1.")
  if (!feedback %in% c(0, 0.5, 1)) stop("Feedback must be 0 or 1. (or init value)")
  if (!is.numeric(omega) || omega < 0 || omega > 1) stop("Omega must be between 0 and 1.")
  
  # Create current choice based on previous choice and feedback
  
  choice_prob <- prevChoice + omega*(feedback - prevChoice)
  
  # enter choice in bernoulli distribution to get a binary choice
  
  choice <- rbinom(1, 1, choice_prob)
  
  return(choice)
  
} 


#### IMPLEMENT EXTRACTION OF CHOICE PROB

```


```{r}

## Setting initial choices 

# For WSLS, we can start with a random choice
wsls_init <- sample(c(0, 1), 1)

# For RL, we start with 0.5

prevChoice_init <- 0.5 

feedback_init <- 0.5


# Setting up vectors for data storage 

wsls_choices_vs_rl <- rep(NA, trials)
feedback_vs_rl <- rep(NA, trials)

rl_choices_vs_wsls <- rep(NA, trials)
feedback_vs_wsls <- rep(NA, trials)

## Insert first choices

wsls_choices_vs_rl[1] <- agent_wsls(wsls_init, feedback_init)
rl_choices_vs_wsls[1] <- agent_rl(prevChoice_init, feedback_init)

## Setup game loop 

for (t in 2:trials) {}




```
